<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Current state:
# - Divider at col 37
# - Gray L: rows 18-29, cols 15-29
# - Yellow L: rows 42-53, cols 3-17

#

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

print("After LEFT 2:")
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] >= 40:
        print(f"  Gray L: pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={n['boundary']}")
    if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] > 5:
        print(f"  Yellow: pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={n['boundary']}")
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] == 64:
        print(f"  Black L: boundary={n['boundary']}")

# Check divider
divider_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'S' and n['pixels'] > 20]
for n in divider_nodes:
    print(f"  Divider: pixels={n['pixels']}, boundary={n['boundary'][:4]}")

# Check blue dots

print(f"\nBlue dots: {len(blue_dots)}")
for d in blue_dots:
    print(f"  {d['boundary']}")

# Check yellow dots

print(f"Yellow dots: {len(yellow_dots)}")

print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
